figurative_meaning_en: Someone who suffers from stomach ailments
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে পেটরোগা বলে ভারী খাবার এড়িয়ে চলে।
পেটরোগা লোকের জন্য হালকা খাবারই ভালো।
example_sentences_in_english: He avoids heavy food because he is stomach-sickly.
Light meals are best for someone with stomach problems.
note: This idiom is straightforward and commonly used in everyday Bengali to describe chronic stomach issues, reflecting cultural emphasis on digestive health.
